significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) invariance: a deliberately induced "canary trait" remains behaviorally detectable after "keyword sanitation, paraphrase, format changes, and dilution with clean data," while detectability, stealth, utility, and multi-bit capacity vary measurably with watermark strength and dilution. The phenomenon is a transformation-resistant provenance signal, while the mechanism is intentional transmission of a teacher steering direction into the student; together they would constrain which sanitation operations can remove model-level provenance and support a concrete alternative to text-level watermarking such as Kirchenbauer et al. (ICML 2023) and SynthID-Text (Nature 2024), whose practical value depends on robustness under text modification. The negative branch would meaningfully show that subliminal transfer is too model-matched, fragile, or utility-costly for provenance, although determinacy is weakened by the conflict between "ANY model" and the stated "same-base-model requirement" and by the absence of a claimed dilution threshold. Under topic substitution, merely extending subliminal-learning research would not earn this score; the specific robustness invariance and provenance consequence are what place it above the topic-median hypothesis.

reach.justification: The named handle is a "robust, black-box data-provenance watermark," operationally a secret canary-trait score and "likelihood-ratio test between the canary trait and unused decoy traits" that an auditor can use to gate or investigate a trained model. Embedding is ex ante, but detection is post-training; it can still provide an action window before a suspect model is trusted or shipped, and its consumers could include dataset owners and deployment auditors rather than only subliminal-learning researchers. After per-base re-extraction, the asserted survival across paraphrasing, sanitation, format changes, and dilution would remain a transferable qualitative relation, but the conclusion does not predict numerical detection power on a new model and explicitly limits scope to models sharing or behaviorally matching the generating base. The topic alone supplies neither this audit handle nor practitioner uptake, so the topic-substitution check does not sustain the score; the matched-base restriction prevents broader 9–10 reach.
